rules.name: Service Area Pre-Activation Validation
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be used to validate new Order Requests unless it is in an active state.
rules.condition: when an Order Request is submitted for a specific geographic zone
exceptions: Emergency override protocols defined in FR-050
rules.if_violated: The order request is rejected and the customer is notified of service unavailability in that zone
rules.rationale: Ensures orders are only processed in zones where operational readiness and logistics support are confirmed

parameters.name: active_state_threshold
parameters.description: The required status for a Service Area to accept orders

rules.name: Regulatory Zone Boundary Constraint
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition may only be created if its geographic boundaries do not overlap with any zone restricted by the Regulatory Authority.
rules.condition: during the creation of a new Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The creation request is automatically rejected and an audit trail is generated for regulatory review
rules.rationale: Prevents illegal operations in restricted areas and ensures adherence to local laws

parameters.name: restricted_zone_list
parameters.description: Current list of geographically restricted zones

rules.name: Dynamic Surge Pricing Eligibility
rules.statement: Surge pricing may only be applied when the ratio of active orders to available delivery agents exceeds the configured capacity threshold AND the predicted wait time does not exceed the maximum acceptable delay defined in the Service Area Definition.
rules.condition: when calculating delivery fees during periods of high demand
rules.if_violated: The surge pricing calculation is bypassed, and standard rates are applied to maintain customer trust
rules.rationale: Balances revenue optimization with the core value proposition of ultra-fast delivery

parameters.name: capacity_threshold_ratio
parameters.description: The minimum order-to-agent ratio required to trigger surge pricing

parameters.name: max_acceptable_delay
parameters.description: The maximum wait time allowed before surge pricing is prohibited

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Synchronization
rules.statement: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot must be updated to mark items as unavailable if the logistics link status indicates a network disruption or route constraint.
rules.condition: when external network status indicates a route constraint or latency threshold is exceeded
exceptions: Manual override by Store Partner for critical items
rules.if_violated: Customers may receive orders that cannot be fulfilled, leading to cancellations and reputational damage
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling by ensuring inventory data reflects actual logistical capability

parameters.name: network_disruption_threshold
parameters.description: The latency level considered a network disruption
